chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played All Streams Flow to the Sea on Nibbit, then Read the Current on Nibbit, spending both energy. With Charge 12, Read the Current's conditional 6 damage applies, so the two attacks deal 24 total damage and leave Nibbit at 16 HP. I did not play Coral Guard or Water's Edge.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered All Streams Flow to the Sea plus Coral Guard, because it would gain 5 Block and reduce the telegraphed 12 damage to 7. I rejected it because the telegraphed attack is not close to killing me and the extra damage from Read the Current is the larger immediate effect.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up 5 Block and the reduced incoming damage. It takes the full 12 damage, leaving me at 36 HP after the telegraphed attack instead of 41 HP, and leaves no defensive buffer for the next turn.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes, if the enemy had telegraphed a much larger attack where 5 Block would change survival, I would have included Coral Guard. A Defend intent or a smaller attack would not have changed the line.
